abbott_smith_html:
περι-βόλαιον, -ου, τό
(περιβάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for כְּסוּת, לְבוּשׁ and cognate forms ;]
that which is thrown around, a covering, in NT,
__(a) a mantle (Psa.102:27, Isa.59:17, al.) : Heb.1:12" (LXX)
__(b) a veil: 1Co.11:15 (but see ICC, in l).†
(AS)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: something thrown around one, i.e. a mantle, veil
strongs_1890.derivation: neuter of a presumed derivative of G4016 (περιβάλλω);

lxx_note: [in LXX chiefly for כְּסוּת, לְבוּשׁ and cognate forms ;]

occurrences.bsb: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.
occurrences.kjv: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.

occurrences.bsb: You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed; but You remain the same, and Your years will never end.”
occurrences.kjv: And as a vesture shalt thou fold them up, and they shall be changed: but thou art the same, and thy years shall not fail.
